verified_defects.where: web/compete/overview.js (Your stats card) and web/compete/rankings/rankings.js (Performance summary, Your ranks, Trap Index)
verified_defects.what: Decision 7 says to hide zeros and defaults, but a new learner sees a wall of placeholders. Overview Your stats shows five tiles reading '—' (WEEK RANK, ALL-TIME RANK, POINTS THIS WEEK, CONTESTS, BEST DAILY). Rankings Performance summary shows seven '—' tiles plus 'CHALLENGE STREAK 0' and the default 'PEAK RATING 1,000'. 'Your ranks' is one row of four '—'. The Trap Index lists 12 traps whose field and 'You' columns are '—'. That is 74 dashes on /compete/rankings/ for a new learner.
verified_defects.fix: Render only tiles and cells that have a value. With no ranked sitting, collapse Your stats and the Performance summary to the existing 'Finish a ranked contest…' line plus the Placing badge. Hide the Your ranks row until a rank exists. In the Trap Index, drop the 'You' column when you have no chances and show only traps with field or own data (keep the trap of the week).

verified_defects.what:
Decision 7 says explanatory sentences become tooltips or help, not permanent text, yet many permanent ones remain:
- Contest lobby: 'The clock runs only while a question is open. Skipped and voided questions score 0.', 'Racing never changes your rank: …', 'Official time: placed on the public board.'
- Board name field: 'Shown on public boards. Don't use your full name.'
- Rematch: 'Same types, new numbers, the same traps. Coming back in 2 days…'
- Contest QOTD panel: 'Today's question; answering it here counts like on Today.'
- Overview: Champions 'Last week's podiums show here once a week closes…', Private contests 'Private contests are for friends…', Season 'Every ranked contest adds to your season points.'
- Leaderboard: the metric help paragraph ('10 / 20 / 30 for each easy…') and 'Weekly boards reset Monday 00:00 UTC…'.
- Rankings: 'Contest rating moves only on ranked contest answers…' and 'The median is measured from students at each level…'.
verified_defects.fix: Move these into UI.tooltip or ⓘ popovers on the control they explain, or into the How it's ranked rules and ? sheet. Keep lines an acceptance check names, such as C17's extended-time consequence line, and keep data lines such as par.

verified_defects.what: The Contest history Time column always shows '—'. The page reads res.secs, but /api/compete/history rows carry result.ms (600000 for a 10:00 sitting) and no secs.
verified_defects.fix: Use `res.secs ?? (res.ms != null ? res.ms / 1000 : undefined)` before falling back to '—'.

verified_defects.where: web/compete/rankings/rankings.js (the expanded history row's mini board)
verified_defects.what: The mini board's rank text reads '=#1 Student 8BF0' and '#13 Student E786': the tie mark and '#' are combined, unlike every other board, which shows '=1'.
verified_defects.fix: Format ranks as on UI.board: '=1' for ties, a plain number otherwise.

verified_defects.what: The owner of a private contest sees no owner controls (Copy link or code, Rename, Extend, Close, Delete). GET /api/contest/{cid} returns no `owner` or `code`, and the page only falls back to a code saved in localStorage when the contest was created in this browser. The page degrades cleanly, but the controls never show for an owner on another device.
verified_defects.fix: Server owner (the other agent): return `owner: true` and `code` to the owner in GET /api/contest/{cid}. No page change needed.

verified_defects.what: The C4 test-day card (?card=1) adds body.print-card, but no CSS targets it, so on screen the card keeps the shell sidebar and nav. C4's acceptance 4 wants a card page with no nav that prints as one page. I could not verify end to end without a finished Final.
verified_defects.fix: Add `body.print-card #bar, body.print-card .now-strip { display: none }` (or skip UI.shell in card mode), then run the A4 and Letter print-to-PDF check once a Final can be seeded.

verified_defects.what: URL parameters are not validated. A stale or hand-edited `?scope=everyone` sends scope=everyone to the server, which answers 422 instead of the page falling back to the default scope.
verified_defects.fix: Clamp metric, period and scope from the URL to known values (e.g. unknown scope becomes 'all') before the first fetch.

fixer_report:
S8 fixes are done: both blockers and five of the six small defects are fixed, in three commits on v2/s8 (13f2756, 79ab558, 75177fa). The server owner fix is still open. `server/checks/s8.py` (run on `server/s8.db`) prints "S8 checks passed" with 4 PENDING items that depend on other sections, and `server/test_flow.py` prints "all good". The branch is detached, the tree is clean and the port 8028 server is stopped.

I also checked in a headless browser as a new learner and as a learner seeded with one ranked Daily. No page errors. /compete/, the leaderboard and the contest page show no '—'. /compete/rankings/ is down to 23 (see "Still open" below).

**What changed**
- **New shared helper (`web/assets/compete-ui.js`):** `UI.compete.info(text, label)` makes an ⓘ button. It shows a tooltip on hover or focus and a small popup on tap. Its CSS and the `body.print-card` shell-hiding rule are in `web/compete/compete.css`.
- **Blocker 1, placeholders:**
  - Tiles with no value no longer render, on Overview Your stats and on the Rankings Performance summary.
  - Before a first rank, Your stats shows only the level badge, the "Placing" line and "Finish a ranked contest to get a rank."
  - The Performance summary no longer shows a 0 challenge streak, or a 1,000 peak rating before any sitting.
  - The Your ranks card stays hidden until a rank exists, and its empty footer line is gone.
  - The Trap Index lists only traps with field or own data, plus this week's trap (tagged "This week"). The Field and You columns drop when they would be empty. I added an "All N traps" button so every trap and its Drill · 8 is still one tap away (decision 4).
- **Blocker 2, permanent explanations moved into ⓘ:**
  - Contest lobby: the clock and official-time notes share one ⓘ on the timing line. Racing and board name each get one.
  - Contest QOTD panel, Rematch, and on Overview the Champions, Private contests and Season notes.
  - Leaderboard: the metric help, and the reset sentence, which becomes "Resets in X ⓘ".
  - Rankings: the rating card note, and the ladder median note on its column header.
  - Kept in the open: C17's extended-time line, the private-contest timing line, the Rush strikes rule, the wall-clock line and the past-day QOTD line.
- **Contest history Time column:** now reads `result.ms` (10:00 checked).
- **Mini board ranks:** now "=1" or "1", as on the other boards.
- **Test-day card:** now hides the header, sidebar, tab bar and now-strip. I confirmed this by forcing the class on the page, because the card endpoint needs a finished Final.
- **Leaderboard URL:** unknown metric, period or scope values now fall back to points, week and all (`?scope=everyone` checked).

**Still open**
- **Needs the server owner:** GET /api/contest/{cid} should return `owner: true` and `code` to the owner. No page change is needed after that.
- **Needs a seeded Final:** the A4 and Letter print-to-PDF check of the test-day card.
- **Not listed, so not fixed:**
  - The Rankings Level ladder's "Students at it" and "Timed-section median" columns are always '—' (20 dashes). The server sends no data for them.
  - The Seasons "This season" row shows '—' for a new learner (3 dashes).
  - The Trap Index and Rivals help paragraphs are still permanent text.
  - The Overview "Traps this week" card still lists 3 traps with no data for a new learner.

The relayed question ("how much did we lose…") is for the main session. I can't see its run history from this worktree, so I didn't answer it.
